page.content:
Thunder god and protector of Earthrealm.

How Raiden connects

  • Location: Earthrealm — Raiden is the thunder god who protects Earthrealm.
  • Faction: Elder Gods — Raiden answers to the Elder Gods while bending their rules for Earthrealm.

What is Raiden?

Raiden is Earthrealm's lightning god, the advisor who sends Liu Kang and Kung Lao into Mortal Kombat and later pays for bending the rules against Shao Kahn.

Key threads lead to Earthrealm and Elder Gods.
